verificationNotes: All two original paper pages and the one-page guide inspected visually; printed cover confirms Mkalama/Mei2025/Kiswahili/FormOne. Archive attribution is not used in place of printed metadata.

33 independently displayed records preserve all nine main questions and all labels. Matching record2 contains five independently graded pairs; 37 answerable parts total. All source groups and source instructions are retained.

Q1(v) na Q9(b) zimesitishwa bila kubadili maneno ya asili kwa sababu ya utata wa chanzo. Rekodi31/alama96 zinaweza kutumika; rekodi33/alama100 za chanzo zimenakiliwa zote. Huu si mtihani mzima wenye alama zilizothibitishwa.
Q1(vii) contains awkward source wording retained verbatim; model lafudhi follows matching scheme and the described regional pronunciation concept.
SourceGuide pages explicitly allocateQ1 10×1,Q2 5×1,Q3 4×3,Q4 5×2,Q5 5×4,Q6 3×3,Q7 5×2,Q8 4×3,Q9 4×3 =100. No official NECTA allocation is asserted.

Source question spelling/capitalization is retained, including sentesi, mtanzania, ana, repeated/awkward phrases and lowercase stems. Source-page images remain definitive for original formatting and underlining.
Q9(d) direct phonetic correction amedhuru→amezuru and complete sentence are independently prepared; source scheme says Ametembelea. Original question is unchanged.
Source page2 Q9(c) was magnified to resolve the final word as “umeanguka”; transcription matches original and no word in the source question was repaired.
